[DO NOT MERGE] js_of_ocaml (8 packages) (6.5.1~pr2571)

Temporary packages built from ocsigen/js_of_ocaml#2571 (Wasm: make
Binaryen optional) to see how it behaves on opam-repo-ci.

@@ -0,0 +1,47 @@
+opam-version: "2.0"
+synopsis: "Compiler from OCaml bytecode to JavaScript"
+description:
+  "Js_of_ocaml is a compiler from OCaml bytecode to JavaScript. It makes it possible to run pure OCaml programs in JavaScript environment like browsers and Node.js"
+maintainer: ["Ocsigen team <dev@ocsigen.org>"]
+authors: ["Ocsigen team <dev@ocsigen.org>"]
+license: [
+  "GPL-2.0-or-later" "LGPL-2.1-or-later WITH OCaml-LGPL-linking-exception"
+]
+homepage: "https://ocsigen.org/js_of_ocaml/latest/js_of_ocaml/overview.html"
+doc: "https://ocsigen.org/js_of_ocaml/latest/js_of_ocaml/overview.html"
+bug-reports: "https://github.com/ocsigen/js_of_ocaml/issues"
+depends: [
+  "dune" {>= "3.20"}
+  "ocaml" {>= "4.13"}
+  "js_of_ocaml" {= version}
+  "js_of_ocaml-ppx" {= version}
+  "lwt" {>= "2.4.4" & != "5.9.2"}
+  "ppx_devtools-optcomp" {>= "0.1" & with-test}
+  "num" {with-test}
+  "re" {>= "1.9.0" & with-test}
+  "odoc" {with-doc}
+]
+depopts: ["graphics"]
+dev-repo: "git+https://github.com/ocsigen/js_of_ocaml.git"
+x-maintenance-intent: ["(latest)"]
+build: [
+  [
+    "dune"
+    "build"
+    "-p"
+    name
+    "-j"
+    jobs
+    "@install"
+    "@doc" {with-doc}
+  ]
+]
+url {
+  src:
+    "https://github.com/ocsigen/js_of_ocaml/archive/610bfc1f32df2eeb9f6e41ace28d5bbe15a9857e.tar.gz"
+  checksum: [
+    "sha256=0edbe8d7c93476c8dd44898c6345a042a08cba161be46b482b9a4cf711279e0b"
+    "sha512=b3d8fa5fb9e91a3dda86ddb245aafb68adeba7f62389f45ca32590b3be7983e56311bdcb02f7e173568c91ea20b258d76ebdf1cb5aa1c12a4c3081014f3deb57"
+  ]
+}
